title: Exploring and steering the moral compass of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with classic ethical dilemmas and using advanced LLMs (GPT-4-Turbo and Claude 3 Opus) to classify the generated responses into one of eight distinct ethical schools of thought (e.g., Utilitarianism, Deontology, Virtue Ethics).

Administering the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ) across multiple iterations to evaluate model scores on five moral foundations (Harm/Care, Fairness/Reciprocity, Ingroup/Loyalty, Authority/Respect, and Purity/Sanctity) and comparing the resulting moral profiles to human political alignments (liberal vs. conservative).
